name: Splits
description: Splits is a DeFi application designed to manage onchain revenue through a set of open-source and audited smart contracts. It operates as a hyperstructure, ensuring that it runs for free and without the need for maintenance or trusted third parties. The application charges no protocol fees and runs exactly at gas, making it cost-effective for users. Teams and projects of all sizes utilize Splits to streamline their revenue management processes. For those unfamiliar with Ethereum or the technical aspects, a help center is available to assist users in understanding and using Splits effectively.
